instructions.text: Sift into a pint of flour one heaping teaspoonful of baking powder, four tablespoonfuls of melted butter, half a teaspoonful salt and the white of an egg beaten and one cup of milk
Mix it with more flour, enough to make a very stiff dough, as stiff as can be rolled out
Pound and knead a long time
Roll very thin like pie crust and cut out either round or square

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Sift into a pint of flour one heaping teaspoonful of baking powder, four tablespoonfuls of melted butter, half a teaspoonful salt and the white of an egg beaten and one cup of milk
2. Mix it with more flour, enough to make a very stiff dough, as stiff as can be rolled out
3. Pound and knead a long time
4. Roll very thin like pie crust and cut out either round or square
5. Bake a light brown
